static_traits.name: Mark
static_traits.social_status: Recently self-isolating, alienated from friends and family
static_traits.medical_history: without重大身体疾病；此前without类似问题；not yet接受心理咨询或治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、语气平和，能配合并愿意尝试小步变化；自我批评明显，空闲时易过度思考；Neutral attitude偏低落

basic_info.main_problem: 我经常因为自己睡很多而给自己贴上“懒惰的废物”的标签。这些自我批评的想法导致Low sense of self-worth下并影响我的动力。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I noticed these self-labeling thoughts are affecting my academic performance and overall well-being.
growth_experiences: 在本学年开始时，学业成绩开始下滑，伴随来自学业和社会期待的压力；由此出现自我标签（“懒惰的废物”）、Decreased drive、睡眠时间延长，负面思维在晚上和周末更频繁；期间尝试设闹钟、制定学习计划并与朋友交谈但效果有限。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/have not价值

special_situations.event: 晚上和周末空闲时间较多、have not学校事务占据注意力
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我睡得很多、have not保持高效率，就证明我是个懒惰的人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 设定多个闹钟与严格学习计划以逼迫自己改变，若失败则进一步自责与Withdrawal
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我就是个懒惰的废物，睡这么多说明我not救了

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果成绩下降，就等于我本质上懒惰、not会变好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying short-term high-intensity plans; when they are hard to sustain, labeling oneself further and reducing investment in learning
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Worsening grades are proof that I am lazy

special_situations.event: Comparing grades or study status with classmates
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果I am not as good as others，就说明我是懒惰且失败的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tightens the plan or gives up entirely, and reduces interaction with others to avoid being compared
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们都能做到而我做not到，我就是懒

special_situations.event: Considers confiding self-critical thoughts more deeply to friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express vulnerability, I will be thought to be complaining or seeking sympathy, and the relationship will worsen
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 选择沉默与Social withdrawal，not公开自我贬低想法以避免被评判
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am playing the victim / will make me tough it out

core_conflict.wish: 渴望在Academic pressure下被理解、被接纳并获得支持
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评价为懒惰、Being rejected或被羞辱
defense_goal: Preemptively controls external evaluation with self-criticism, reducing the risk of being hit
保持距离、减少求助以避免可能的negate与羞耻

object_relations.self_representation: A flawed, lazy person with low self-worth
object_relations.object_representation: Others/peers who judge harshly and demand 'toughing it out'

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to share inner thoughts more deeply with friends or seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为朋友会觉得自己矫情、会让自己“硬扛”（将内在自我批评Projection到他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以犹豫、含糊的方式婉拒分享，强调“not想显得在求同情”，减少暴露脆弱内容。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing setting goals or trying new strategies (such as recording positive moments)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that once she tries she will fail, and failure will prove she is 'lazy', so she needs to be more cautious or postpone
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use谨慎、保留的语气强调小步和可控性，提出种种顾虑以降低承诺强度。

manifestations: 在成绩下滑后产生“反正I am lazy，努力也not意义”的倾向
Motivation clearly declines; hard to persist with study plans
Actively keeping distance from friends and family
not愿向朋友表达更深层的自我批评想法，担心被视为“矫情”
outcomes: Self-esteem further damaged, motivation continuing to decline

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Expresses himself cautiously in sessions and interpersonal settings, worried about being seen as 'seeking sympathy'
Harsh self-evaluation, finding it hard to let positive experiences in

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, and instead does it to the self, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Wants to seek support but turns to self-blame and self-isolation
Under stress, turns energy into self-derogation or excessive sleep rather than outward expression

exception_events.target_problem: 在空闲时段（尤其晚上与周末），Mark通常会陷入自我标签与过度睡眠，导致难以坚持学习计划并进一步丧失动力。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在设置闹钟后的前1–2天早晨，Mark能够按时起床并短时间遵循学习计划，体验到一些成就感，与以往的拖延与Self-denialnot同。
exception_events.reason: not同做法：use闹钟与学习计划提供外部结构；not同情境：当任务更具体、节奏被结构化时not易过度思考；not同支持：与朋友的交流在当时提供了短暂的情绪缓冲。

positive_force: Has friends to talk to, with some potential for social support
Under external structure (alarm clock, study plan), can enter an execution state in the short term
Willing to try small-step changes (such as recording small positive moments)
Has self-insight into the problem and proactively seeks counseling
Can experience a sense of accomplishment when occasionally sticking to the plan
negative_force: 自我标签化和过度概括Reinforcement负性自我概念
Comparing oneself with others leads to self-deprecation与despair
Mind-reading worry about others' evaluations, reducing help-seeking
Social withdrawal导致支持减少、Loneliness感加剧
Excessive sleep and disordered routine, further weakening motivation and focus

antecedent: Has much free time in evenings and weekends
The alarm rings but inner motivation is lacking
Academic pressure与负性自我评价后产生疲惫感
target_behavior.core_reason: 以睡眠逃避Academic pressure与羞耻/自责的not适情绪；自我标签削弱行动意愿。
target_behavior.function: 逃避not愉快的任务要求与负面情绪体验
target_behavior.consequence: Daily rhythm is disrupted, study time decreases, academic performance declines further

target_behavior.behavior: 自我标签/负性自我对话（“I am lazy废物”）
antecedent: Free time in the evenings and on weekends
target_behavior.core_reason: 认知扭曲（过度概括、个人化、比较与despair）将局部表现推演为整体人格缺陷。
target_behavior.function: 为挫败提供简单解释并短时回避not确定与Anxiety，但削弱改变动机
target_behavior.consequence: Lowered self-esteem、Decreased drive，形成“自责—回避—进一步失败”的恶性循环

target_behavior.behavior: Social withdrawal与not向朋友寻求支持
antecedent: Thinking about sharing self-critical thoughts more deeply
Worried about others' evaluations (being seen as 'pretentious')
target_behavior.core_reason: 对他人反应的读心与Being rejected/羞耻的担忧。
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的negate与羞耻体验，维持表面安全感
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support，Loneliness与负面情绪加剧，问题维持
